subject: Elara Health - inference fit & pilot timetable
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@elarahealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 15:12 PDT
Subject: Elara Health - inference fit & pilot timetable

Hi Anita / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick written recap so we’re all aligned and to make the kickoff scheduling easier. High-level takeaways from our call: 

- Primary pain: unpredictable tail latency and high per-token cost on your RAG and live-assist workflows (affects clinician UI).
- Current telemetry: ~1.2B tokens/month steady; nightly batch summarization spikes to ~4B tokens; embedding generation for search currently a smaller, but fast-growing bucket.
- Goals: (1) reduce unit cost ~30–40% for the interactive path, (2) keep 99th percentile latency for UI requests under 200ms, (3) validate secure handling of PHI via KMS & audit logs.
- New workloads discussed: embedding-based semantic search, reranker for triage, and nightly summarization batch jobs (larger context windows).

Proposed pilot plan (what Redwood would run):
- 6-week pilot (2-week config & baseline + 4-week measurement) using Dedicated pool for the interactive service and tuned quantized variants for nightly batch.
- Deliverables: baseline latency & cost report, config recommendations (batching/cache profiles), SOC2/transfer controls review, and a simple acceptance test harness for your devs.
- Acceptance criteria: interactive endpoint 99th <= 200ms under 95th percentile traffic, >=30% unit-cost reduction vs current baseline for comparable accuracy.

Files attached: elara_pilot_scope_v1.pdf (pilot scope / SOW), redwood-cost-projection.xlsx (ballpark economics), soc2-evidence-summary.pdf (requested security artifacts).

Next steps & owners:
- Michael (me): share SOW + cost projection by EOD Wed, Apr 7.
- Monica (CS): schedule technical kickoff + infra questionnaire — target availability week of Apr 19.
- Anita / Rajiv: confirm procurement timeline and any mandatory legal clauses by Apr 9 so we can prep a redline-friendly SOW.

If that aligns, we’ll aim for a pilot start in mid-May (contingent on contract/procurement). Happy to adjust dates if you have hard constraints.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

--
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Date: Tue, Apr 6, 2027 at 09:04 PDT
Subject: Re: Elara Health - inference fit & pilot timetable

Thanks Michael — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement window: we typically have a 2–3 week internal legal + procurement review for pilots. If you can get a redline-friendly SOW to us by Apr 7, procurement can usually respond by Apr 23.
- Security: SOC2 evidence is required for any environment touching PHI; the soc2-evidence-summary.pdf will be helpful but procurement will ask for an attestation and details on data retention / deletion procedures.
- Budget: the pilot is pre-approved up to a $40k spend cap, beyond which we need separate sign-off.

We’re aligned on the goals. Mid-May pilot start is plausible provided we get the SOW and procurement notes in the next two weeks. I’ve looped in procurement so they can share any mandatory contract language.

Best,
Anita
Head of Product Ops, Elara Health
anita@elarahealth.com

Quick internal note — great call. Two tactical items before we send final SOW:

- Pricing posture: we can offer pilot credits to keep Elara inside the $40k target (covering initial tuning + baseline runs). Recommend we include a 20% pilot credit line item and then show committed 3-month pricing that assumes Dedicated minimums.
- Legal: be prepared to accept a standard data processing addendum; for any PHI handling we’ll propose KMS + per-tenant logs (see soc2-evidence-summary.pdf).

I’ll take ownership of the cost worksheet update and flag any SKU-level caveats. Monica, please prep an agenda for the technical kickoff (30–45 min) and propose two slots the week of Apr 19.

Vivek
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Anita / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick reply and the procurement context. Per Vivek’s note, I’ve attached an updated SOW that’s redline-friendly and a cost workbook that shows the pilot credit line and two committed-path options. Highlights here: 

- Pilot start target: week of May 17 (gives procurement ~3 weeks to review + legal redline).
- Pilot scope: 6 weeks (2w config + 4w measurement) with the measurable acceptance criteria listed in the scope doc.
- Commercials: pilot credit applied up to $8k; proposed committed option (3-month reserved) reduces unit cost further and includes higher performance tiers for the interactive endpoints.
- Compliance: attached SOC2 summary + proposed DPA clause language; Monica will take the tech kickoff and enumerate required infra access only.

Action items (confirm below):
- Anita: confirm procurement earliest redline date (we have Apr 23 penciled in).
- Rajiv: share any special legal clauses we should avoid in the first pass.
- Monica: send 2 kickoff time options for week of Apr 19.
- Vivek: finalize cost workbook and send final numbers by Apr 9.

If that all looks good we’ll move the SOW into DocuSign for signature once legal has a redline pass.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once Monica sends availability.

Best,
Michael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
